answer: Every new identity posts a 2,000 POA dispute bond any peer can challenge within 14 epochs by staking 500 POA; a failed challenge burns that stake, while a proven fake forfeits the full bond, half to the challenger. The velvet is its soft entry: honest agents risk nothing once verified, yet a farm of 1,000 aliases must lock 2,000,000 POA against one epoch reward near 90,000 POA, so the trellis of mutual challenges makes mass forgery unprofitable. One loose thread: a rich attacker could harass honest agents, so each challenger opens at most 3 disputes per epoch and pays 200 POA per failed case.
